May 18, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Naples Global Advisors Llc decreased its stake in General Electric Co (GE) by 36.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Naples Global Advisors Llc sold 37,017 shares as the company’s stock declined 23.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 64,383 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.12M, down from 101,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Naples Global Advisors Llc who had been investing in General Electric Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $130.28 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.20% or $0.03 $15. About 18.89M shares traded. General Electric Company (NYSE:GE) has declined 54.35% downtrending. It has underperformed by 65.90% the S&P500.
Guardian Capital Advisors Lp increased its stake in Telus Corp (TU) by 4.91% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 192,791 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.04 million, up from 183,767 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Guardian Capital Advisors Lp who had been investing in Telus Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $21.01B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.62% or $0.22 $35.43.
